title.zh: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet With BlackRock, DTCC and Visa as Validators
title.en: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet With BlackRock, DTCC and Visa as Validators

current_state.zh: Circle launched its Arc Layer 1 payments blockchain mainnet with USDC as the gas token and founding validators including BlackRock, DTCC, ICE, Mastercard, Visa, and Standard Chartered.
current_state.en: Circle launched its Arc Layer 1 payments blockchain mainnet with USDC as the gas token and founding validators including BlackRock, DTCC, ICE, Mastercard, Visa, and Standard Chartered.
